comparison: live speech supply minus live no-supply control; same service process and source, both stages regenerated
primary_metric: paired per-sample official SLU-F1 in percentage points, matching the inherited S3 estimand
standard_reported_metric: full-manifest official micro SLU-F1; distinguish pooled TP/FP/FN from mean row F1

candidate_rule.primary: NEW500 natural-mixture row SLU-F1 CI90 lower bound > 0
candidate_rule.protection: NEW500 intent, scenario and action accuracy point changes are each nonnegative; malformed final delivery and output saturation counts do not increase

interpretation: The protection rule is a prospective descriptive policy guard, not a non-inferiority or equivalence test. Historical np8/max64 null margins do not calibrate this np4/max256 live system. A positive first system comparison is bounded discovery evidence, not a new confirmatory or generalization claim.
further_contact: No adaptive rerun, reasoning arm, new roster or automatic extra control. Any minimum same-configuration repetition must have a named decision purpose and separate prospective registration.
cost: Report all direct and slots generation, two live fits, actual failures/fallbacks, packet/input size, service load, generation, preparation/barrier waiting and score tail separately.
attribution: OBS uses identical validated speech features; ORG retains original examples and live predicted intent schema; SUPPLY adds the inherited speech-keyed top-five TRAIN filler supply only in slots; USE remains the same frozen Solver. Report the full system and component references separately.
